Bihar ke navada jile ke pakribravan thana kshetr antargat bujurg bariyari ganv se rishton ko tar-tar kar dene vali khauphnak vardat samne aaee hai. mahaj ek dismil jamin ke mamuli vivad men chhote bhaee ne apne 55 varshiy bare bhaee nandlal pandit ko dhakka de diya, jisse ve jamin par gir pare aur phir dobara nahin uth sake.
Aanan-phanan men parijan unhen aspatal le gae, jahan chikitsakon ne unhen mrit ghoshit kar diya. mritak ke putr mukesh pandit ne apne chhote chacha aur parivar ke any sadasyon par pita ki hatya karne ka ganbhir aarop lagate hue thane men prathmiki darj karaee hai.
